title: Finding
description: One claim an iteration makes. Findings are typed so the ledger can be generated rather than hand-maintained, and so supersession is a field rather than prose.

estimand.description: The quantity estimated, in its own units.

multiple_testing.description: Correction applied, and over how many tests.

n.description: Units of analysis supporting the claim.

behaved.description: False means the pipeline was diagnosed, not the biology.

basis.description: How the limit was derived. A null result IS this number.

confounders_unexcluded.description: Named explicitly. An empty array is a strong claim and is rarely honest in an observational design.

status.description: `candidate` until orthogonally validated. Most findings never leave it.

superseded_by.description: Finding id that overturned this one. The superseded record is never edited or deleted.
